messages.subject: User wait notification (simultaneous users, scheduler)
parts:
Hi,

How would you recommend showing the user that all available threads are in use? I have an application that takes a long time to run and when a thread is unavailable the application simply does nothing. I'd like to let the users connect but inform them to wait while different users are consuming all of the server's resources, instead of thinking the application is broken. I am using pro with the utilization_scheduler FWIW.

Thanks,

Chris
